mapper.select: SELECT SD.OrderProdNo AS orderProdNo, SD.OrderChangeNo AS orderChangeNo, SD.OrderType AS orderType, SD.ProdName AS prodName, SD.ItemName AS itemName, SD.ProdQty AS prodQty, SD.SalePrice AS salePrice, SD.DeliCompCode AS deliCompCode, COALESCE(DC.DeliCompName, SD.DeliCompName) AS deliCompName, DC.LinkUrl AS linkUrl, DC.InvNoVar AS invNoVar, SD.InvNo AS invNo, SD.PrevInvNo AS prevInvNo, SD.InvChangeReason AS invChangeReason, SD.InvChangeReasonDetail AS invChangeReasonDetail, SD.OrderState AS orderState, CAST(SD.ShipDirectDate AS CHAR) AS shipDirectDate, CAST(SD.ShipCheckDate AS CHAR) AS shipCheckDate, CAST(SD.ShipCmpletDate AS CHAR) AS shipCmpletDate, CAST(SD.DeliCmpletDate AS CHAR) AS deliCmpletDate, CAST(SD.ShipCancelRqstDate AS CHAR) AS shipCancelRqstDate, CAST(SD.ShipCancelCmpletDate AS CHAR) AS shipCancelCmpletDate FROM shopwizard.tShpShipDirect SD LEFT OUTER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpDeliComp DC ON DC.DeliCompCode = SD.DeliCompCode WHERE SD.OrderNo = #{orderNo} ORDER BY SD.OrderProdNo, SD.OrderChangeNo

SELECT RD.OrderProdNo AS orderProdNo, RD.OrderChangeNo AS orderChangeNo, RD.OrderType AS orderType, RD.ProdName AS prodName, RD.ItemName AS itemName, RD.ProdQty AS prodQty, RD.SalePrice AS salePrice, RD.DeliCompCode AS deliCompCode, COALESCE(DC.DeliCompName, RD.DeliCompName) AS deliCompName, DC.LinkUrl AS linkUrl, DC.InvNoVar AS invNoVar, RD.InvNo AS invNo, RD.ReturnReason AS returnReason, RD.ReturnReasonDetail AS returnReasonDetail, RD.OrderState AS orderState, CAST(RD.ReturnReciptDate AS CHAR) AS returnReciptDate, CAST(RD.ReturnRqstDate AS CHAR) AS returnRqstDate, CAST(RD.ReturnConfrmDate AS CHAR) AS returnConfrmDate, CAST(RD.ReturnCmpletDate AS CHAR) AS returnCmpletDate FROM shopwizard.tShpReturnDirect RD LEFT OUTER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpDeliComp DC ON DC.DeliCompCode = RD.DeliCompCode WHERE RD.OrderNo = #{orderNo} ORDER BY RD.OrderProdNo, RD.OrderChangeNo

SELECT P.PayNo AS payNo, P.PayType AS payType, CV.ConstrValDesc AS payTypeName, CAST(P.PayDate AS CHAR) AS payDate, P.PayExpectAmt AS payExpectAmt, P.PayAmt AS payAmt, COALESCE(NULLIF(P.CardComp, ''), P.ReciptBank) AS payCompName, P.ApprovNo AS approvNo, CAST(P.ApprovDate AS CHAR) AS approvDate, P.PgCode AS pgCode, P.ReciptName AS reciptName FROM shopion.tOrdOrderPay P LEFT OUTER JOIN wizardn.tCodConstrVal CV ON CV.ConstrCode = 'cPayType' AND CV.ConstrVal = P.PayType WHERE P.OrderNo = #{orderNo} ORDER BY P.PayNo
